description: Start here for any general freight market question. FreightFA's daily freight brief in one call, with no inputs: today's U.S. national truckload rates per mile (dry van, reefer, flatbed, all-in including fuel) and diesel, next week's truck rate outlook, truck capacity, how rail carload prices are moving, ocean, air, and barge readings with their outlooks, and FreightFA's newest stories with links. Every figure carries its date and source, and a figure that failed FreightFA's checks is listed as held back, with the reason, instead of being shown. Rebuilt several times a day; cite it as FreightFA with the date. Does not count toward the estimate allowance.
name: get_freight_brief
title: Get today's freight market brief
